subject: design/argus-journal-type-recovery
statement: The normal document gate's registered `check-delivery-types` check validates changed delivery ledgers against their trusted base. A newly introduced unknown event refuses even if a later same-proposal correction tries to cover it. A historical unsupported event is tolerated only when a valid appended correction resolves it. Unresolved historical errors receive a specific recovery diagnostic rather than an unexplained capture-path refusal. Unchanged legacy ledgers do not block unrelated application changes. Pushed heads are read from Git rather than another session's working tree. The Source legacy-document exemption retains this Argus integrity check, as it retains attribution and history.
